## 更新内容

- 修复首页中文主标题的断行问题：扩大标题可用宽度，桌面端在空间允许时保持“面向企业研发与科研团队的统一 AI 模型平台”单行显示。
- 增加更稳妥的文本换行策略；在移动端或较窄窗口中仍会自然换行，避免拆分词组、溢出或遮挡地球场景。
- 保持英文、简体中文、其他现有语言以及浅色/深色主题的兼容性，并补充标题布局回归测试。

## 升级说明

- 本版本不包含数据库结构变更。
- 可由平台管理员在“平台更新”页面检查并手动更新。

## English

- Fixes the Chinese home-page headline wrapping by widening its available measure so “面向企业研发与科研团队的统一 AI 模型平台” stays on one line on desktop when space permits.
- Uses a safer text-wrapping strategy for narrow windows and mobile layouts, preventing awkward word splits, overflow, or overlap with the Earth scene.
- Preserves English, Simplified Chinese, the other existing locales, and light/dark theme compatibility, with regression coverage for the heading layout.

## Upgrade Notes

- This release contains no database schema changes.
- Platform administrators can detect and install this release manually from the **Platform Update** page.
